images.title: Sort each product by identity
images.purpose: Shows the identity sort in its simplest state: four product cards, each dropped into the bin of the identity that fits.
images.composition: Four bins in a row along the bottom, one card resting just above each bin. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Four open bins of equal size in a row. Bin labels: teal (#0072B2) '(a + b)²', amber (#E69F00) '(a − b)²', reddish purple (#CC79A7) '(a + b)(a − b)', grey (#6B7280) 'none'. Above each bin, one white card with a dark outline and a short down arrow into the bin: '46²' above '(a + b)²', '91²' above '(a − b)²', '397 × 403' above '(a + b)(a − b)', '(p − 1)(p + 11)' above 'none'. Exactly 4 bins and 4 cards.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Match the product to its identity first; if none fits, distribute.
